name: Higold Group Co., LTD.
summary: Higold Group Co., LTD. engages in the research, production, and sale of home hardware products worldwide. The company provides functional hardware, basic hardware, kitchen and bathroom hardware, cabinet lighting, interior door locks, smart kitchenware products, and outdoor furniture. It also offers kitchen and wardrobe storage hardware; hinges, guides, and drawers; sink faucets; and clothes racks. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Foshan, China. Higold Group Co., LTD. is a subsidiary of Guangdong Higold Management Group Co., Ltd.
